The developer's brief calls for a high-density building targeting middle-income renters and lessees, with saleable space set at 70% and non-saleable space at 30% of the leasable portion — itself 85% of the total gross floor area (TGFA) — and the building is meant to double as a neighborhood landmark built at the lowest feasible cost.
